event.name: STORM_BOARDING
event.title: Boarders: Humans in plasma storm
event.text: You find two heavily damaged ships floating nearby, the remains of a battle. You begin to harvest some usable debris when you hear the sounds of someone beaming aboard followed by the shouts of a boarding party.

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-in-plasma-storm:0
choice.text: You receive medium scrap with resources

event.name: BROKEN_REBEL_DRONE
event.title: Deactivated Auto-ship
event.text: You find a Rebel automated scout floating near this beacon. Despite its pristine condition, it appears to be de-activated.

choice.name: c:deactivated-auto-ship:0
choice.text: Don't risk activating it, and just strip the ship for any useful scrap

choice.name: c:free-drone-schematic:0
choice.text: You receive a drone schematic with low scrap

event.name: FREE_ITEMS
event.title: Free scrap with resources
event.text: You arrive in a system and immediately discover a pirate ship nearby. Strangely, scans indicate there are no lifeforms aboard. You salvage anything useful, but find no clue as to the whereabouts of the former crew.
Not much remains in this abandoned system; however, scans reveal a nearby mining platform with some salvageable materials.
As you arrive in the system you are hailed by a loyalist settlement. Upon learning of your quest, they offer you supplies.
Debris from a forgotten battle still orbits the gas giant in this system. Some of it still might be usable.

You receive a message from a nearby station, "A Federation cruiser jumping into Rebel territory? Quite the bold move." You quickly move to arm the weapons but he continues, "Lucky for you we're not all in support of the Rebellion. Perhaps these supplies will help you get to friendlier space alive."
You happen upon the remains of a space station. It has been mostly picked clean but there appears to be a few materials that will aid you in your mission.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources:0
choice.text: You receive medium scrap with resources

event.name: LANIUS_FREE_STUFF
event.title: Free scrap with resources (Lanius)
event.text: You stumble across a badly damaged Lanius craft. It jumps away as soon as it sees you. Looking around the area, you discover a number of destroyed Rebel automated ships. It must have been quite the fight. You scrap what remains.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-lanius:0
choice.text: You receive high scrap with resources

event.name: LANIUS_TRADER
event.title: Lanius trader
event.text: Aided by a modified translator, a nearby Lanius scavenger ship messages you, saying, "Metal sufficient. Request exchange." It appears there are some Lanius who wish sociable interaction with other races.

A small Lanius craft approaches. You prepare for a fight but they do not seem to be carrying any weapons. After a brief moment they message you, although your translator struggles with the unfamiliar dialect. It appears they wish to trade.
You arrive to find a large Lanius vessel laden with recently collected metal. They are apparently offering to trade for supplies they are lacking.

choice.name: c:lanius-trader:0
choice.text: You lose 3-7 fuel and receive 15-30 scrap

choice.name: c:lanius-trader:1
choice.text: You lose 3-7 missiles and receive 20-40 scrap

choice.name: c:lanius-trader:2
choice.text: You lose 3-7 drone parts and receive 20-40 scrap

choice.name: c:lanius-trader-with-translator:0
choice.text: You lose 3-7 fuel and receive 15-30 scrap

choice.name: c:lanius-trader-with-translator:1
choice.text: You lose 3-7 missiles and receive 20-40 scrap

choice.name: c:lanius-trader-with-translator:2
choice.text: You lose 3-7 drone parts and receive 20-40 scrap

event.name: QUEST_MANTIS_INVASION_START
event.title: Mantis war camp
event.text: You receive a request, "All of our military ships have been destroyed or damaged during the rebellion. However, there have been reports of a Mantis war camp only a few jumps from us. Can you help?"

choice.name: c:mantis-war-camp:0
choice.text: Pledge to do what you can

event.name: REFUEL_STATION
event.title: Refueling station
event.text: A ship re-fueling station is stationed at this beacon. We can purchase fuel here.

event.name: SELL_DRONES_STATION
event.title: Sell drone parts for scrap
event.text: You see a civilian space station with heavy damage. You receive a message, "We've been hit hard by the war. We need more drone parts to speed up our repairs. We'll buy some from you if you have extra."

event.name: SELL_MISSILES_STATION
event.title: Sell missiles for scrap
event.text: There is a black market hub here. You receive a message, "These are dangerous times. If you have extra military-grade explosives, we'll gladly pay you for them."

event.name: QUEST_CONSTRUCTIONYARD
event.title: Space station under construction
event.text: You come across a space station under construction. You receive a message from their command tower, "Greetings. We recently lost contact with a cargo ship that was set to deliver more construction materials. Could you help us figure out what happened to them?"

event.name: LANIUS_PIRATE_BOARDERS
event.title: Boarders: Humans (Abandoned)
event.text: An image of some weak and hungry humans comes onto your screen. "Those metal bastards think they can just absorb half of our engines and leave us here to die? I hope you understand the need to take your ship by force."

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-abandoned:0
choice.text: 3-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship

event.name: QUEST_ESCORT
event.title: Escort civilians
event.text: After a short time you receive a message, "Hello. I hope it's not a bother, but I'm looking for an escort to a nearby system. This region is quite dangerous and our ship is not well-armed."
There is a single ship at this beacon. They hail you, "We could really use some help. Our FTL navigation system is shot. Can you help us get to a nearby station where they can patch us up?"
"Hello," your communicator opens a hail from a nearby ship. "Our weapon systems are malfunctioning and we're too afraid of pirates to travel home unassisted. Can you escort us?"

event.name: FIND_WEAPON
event.title: Free weapon
event.text: Holy crap! A weapon is just floating in space!
You inform a nearby station of your flight from the Rebels. They offer to outfit your ship with a weapon and wish you well.
A settlement still loyal to the Federation hails your ship. They have prepared a weapon to aid your escape from the Rebels.
As soon as you arrive a small Mantis ship detaches from a wreck and jumps away. You must have interrupted their salvage operation because you find a weapon ready to be installed!
A small merchant ship messages you, "Underground Federation comm channels are all talking about your 'secret' mission. Let us install a weapon to help. Good luck!"
Debris from a battle is scattered around this system. A few pieces bounce against your ship. You passively scan them and discover there is a functioning weapon among them!

choice.name: c:free-weapon:0
choice.text: You receive a weapon with low scrap

event.name: NEBULA_BOARDING
event.title: Boarders: Humans in nebula
event.text: You see a small station nearby and feel the shudder of shots ringing through the ship. You can't be sure without sensors, but it seems there may be intruders on the ship!

You arrive in the nebula and immediately receive a message from an unknown source, "Prepare to be boarded!" With the static from the nebula, there's no way to tell where they came from, but you hear shots fired on board the ship.
You see a number of derelict ships near this beacon. After a short time you hear the tell-tale sounds of a teleporter and shouts coming from within the ship. You've been boarded!

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-in-nebula:0
choice.text: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: NEBULA_REBEL_BOARDING
event.title: Boarders: rebels in nebula
event.text: There appear to be a number of small stations nearby. Before you have time to scan them, warnings go off. A Rebel teleporter was used in one of the stations. You've been boarded!

choice.name: c:boarders-rebels-in-nebula:0
choice.text: 3-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: REPAIR_STATION
event.title: Repair station
event.text: You see a small station fitted with hundreds of Repair drones. You receive an automated message, "We don't know who you are and we don't care, but this is the right place for some ship repair!"
"Thank you for your business, no refunds!"
"Thank you for your business, no refunds!"
"Thank you for your business, no refunds!"

event.name: FUEL_FOR_DRONE
event.title: Trade fuel for drone parts
event.text: A nearby space station hails you. "Greetings! Your arrival is most fortuitous. We recently came across some extra drones. If you have some fuel, perhaps we can make a deal?"
A strange vessel approaches. A digital message appears on your view-screen: "This is an automated merchant. Refill this vessel with fuel and it will supply you with drones."
You arrive in the sector and are greeted by a science vessel waiting by the beacon. They hail you, "We find ourselves low on fuel and have a proposition."

event.name: TRADER_CIV
event.title: Trade resources
event.text: You arrive at a quiet spaceport and are immediately hailed by another ship at port with a "once in a lifetime deal!"
You jump into a sector filled with civilian activity. Your scan the various advertisement channels while waiting for your FTL to charge, and are intrigued by a grey-market shipwright.
Your ship is flooded with advertisement transmissions from nearby merchants as soon as you arrive at this beacon. You arbitrarily pick one to examine in detail.
Despite the barren area, a trader has set up shop at this beacon. He presents his offer.
The beacon at first glance seems home to a junk yard. Upon closer inspection, it reveals itself to be a ramshackle market. One trader has a deal that catches your eye.
A pawn broker has set up shop at this obscure beacon. He might be offering something worth looking at.

event.name: BOARDERS_CRYSTAL
event.title: Boarders: Crystal
event.text: You arrive near a small settlement and a lone guard ship moves to intercept you. You try to contact them but they are refusing all hails. Suddenly you hear lasers ricocheting from within the ship. You've been boarded!

You detect a heavily armed Crystalline ship escorting some sort of prison vessel. Scans indicate there are a number of non-Crystal based life forms aboard; they must be rounding up all of the intruders in their space! Before you can react, you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter going off.

You arrive near a small settlement and a lone guard ship moves to intercept you. You try to contact them but they are refusing all hails. Suddenly you hear lasers ricocheting from within the ship. You've been boarded!

You pick up chatter from a nearby ship, "Yes... Here are some interesting specimens. Try to take them alive this time, there's a lot of money to be had on aliens." Scanners indicate a remote teleporter was just used.

choice.name: c:boarders-crystal:0
choice.text: 2-3 crystal boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: CONFUSED_MANTIS
event.title: Confused Mantis
event.text: As soon as you jump into the system, you receive a hail from a nearby civilian Engi vessel. Their Captain appears on your screen: "Strange bug. Can you assist in debugging?"

choice.name: c:confused-mantis:1
choice.text: Explain that you can't do any programming and leave.

event.name: BOARDERS_SUN
event.title: Boarders: Humans near sun
event.text: You arrive to find yourself extremely close to a star. You receive a message from a pirate ship, "I'm glad you arrived; our ship is damaged and we were getting desperate... I hope you don't mind if we take yours." Hostiles detected on board our ship!

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-near-sun:0
choice.text: 2-4 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: MANTIS_BOARDERS
event.title: Boarders: Mantis
event.text: A derelict and still smoking Mantis vessel floats by. The battle must have been recent; its surviving crew beam aboard. Prepare for a fight!
Your world, all of a sudden, changes. The Mantis are on board your ship.
You hear a grating rattle and a soft clicking. You reach for your pistol.

choice.name: c:boarders-mantis:0
choice.text: 2-4 mantis boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: MANTIS_CREW
event.title: Escape pod
event.text: You detect and retrieve an escape pod floating nearby. You consider returning it to space when you learn it's Mantis.
A Mantis boarder and a lost crewmember, or nothing.

event.name: REFUGEE_NO_DISTRESS_PIRATE
event.title: Refugee (Pirate)
event.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

event.name: REFUGEE_DISTRESS_PIRATE
event.title: Refugee distress (Pirate)
event.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

event.name: STATION_SICK
event.title: Research station with no response
event.text: You arrive to find a small research station putting out a distress signal. There is no response to your hails.

choice.name: c:research-station-with-no-response:0
choice.text: Dock with the station and investigate.

event.text: The station investigation.

choice.name: c:research-station-with-no-response:2
choice.text: Send your battle drone in to help.

event.text: Nothing, or medium scrap with resources.
Medium scrap with resources, or nothing.

event.name: ROCK_BOARDERS_SUN
event.title: Boarders: Rockmen near sun
event.text: As soon as you arrive you hear the telltale sounds of a teleporter and shouts reverberating through the ship, "Prepare to burn, fleshy meat-sack aliens!"
With their high resistance to heat, outlaw Rocks often settle very close to stars. That is why it is hardly surprising when your ship gets boarded as you stumble past a hidden settlement.

choice.name: c:boarders-rockmen-near-sun:0
choice.text: 2-3 rock boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: ROCK_SLUG_ARGUMENT
event.title: Rock and Slug standoff
event.text: You find a Slug Cruiser and Rock ship at a standoff, both with weapons armed and ready to fight. You could intervene before this gets out of hand.

choice.name: c:rock-and-slug-standoff:0
choice.text: Hail them to see what's wrong.

event.text: Pay the debt, demand payment, or leave.
Nothing happens.

event.name: ROCK_MANTIS_FREIGHTER
event.title: Mantis ships battle for Rock freighter
event.alias: Mantis ships battle for Rock freighter
Mantis Ships Battle for Rock Freighter
Mantis ships battle for Rock Freighter
event.text: A curious sight greets you at this beacon: a disabled Rock freighter drifts in space while two Mantis craft battle it out - presumably over who deserves the spoils.

choice.name: c:mantis-ships-battle-for-rock-freighter:0
choice.text: Wait, then attack the surviving Mantis.

event.text: A weakened Mantis ship, or a Mantis ship.
Nothing happens.
High scrap.
A Mantis ship.

event.name: ROCK_STARSHIP_MINE
event.title: Rock live mine
event.text: The burnt out hull of a Rock mine layer drifts by. Behind the wreck drifts a live mine; an automated drone that drills into ships' hulls before exploding. It locks onto your ship's signature and heads your way!
The mine bites down.
Nothing happens.

event.name: SLUG_DISTRESS_RESCUE
event.title: Slocknog
event.text: You detect life signs on a nearby moon - a lone Slug marooned on its surface. "Ah, a sssentient ssspecies, after all this time. I am Slocknog, a wandering hero ssseeking adventure. You may hire me for a ssmall sssum."

event.name: REFUGEE_NO_DISTRESS_SLUG
event.title: Refugee (Slug)
event.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

event.name: REFUGEE_DISTRESS_SLUG
event.title: Refugee distress (Slug)
event.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
A trade, or a pirate ship using them as bait.

event.name: ZOLTAN_FREE_AUGMENT
event.title: Zoltan free augment
event.text: A Zoltan academy sits docked just outside the beacon perimeter. They're happy to show you the fruits of their labor, and offer something to take home with you.

choice.name: c:zoltan-free-augment:0
choice.text: You receive an augmentation with low scrap

event.name: BOARDERS_HACKING
event.title: Boarders: Humans jammed sensors
event.text: You catch a glimpse of a strange signal coming from a space station before your sensors shut off unexpectedly. As you discover that your sensors are being jammed, you hear hostiles beam onto your ship.

event.name: NEBULA_ZOLTAN_EYE
event.title: Zoltan Great Eye
event.text: Inside this nebula you detect a rogue planet drifting through space, on its surface a huge monolith visible at this distance even to the naked eye. A Zoltan elder hails you from the planet. "Through luck or intent, you have discovered the Great Eye. Look into its depths and receive your just deserts."
Lose a crewmember, a Zoltan ship, high scrap, or Healing Burst.

choice.name: c:no-fuel-rebel-fleet-delay:0
choice.text: Rebel Fleet pursuit is delayed for 1 jump

event.text: Another out of fuel event occurs.

event.name: NO_FUEL_REFUGEE_FRIENDLY
event.title: No fuel: friendly refugee
event.text: While it doesn't have much fuel to spare, it recognizes you are part of the Federation and offers to split its remaining fuel with you.

event.name: FUEL_TRADER
event.title: No fuel: fuel trader (distress off)
event.text: A merchant ship jumps into the sector and you quickly hail them asking for help. They respond, "Perhaps we could work out an exchange..."
A number of ships pass through the sector. You relay your message to each, and one finally responds. "I can't help much right now but perhaps we can trade."

A nearby settlement sends a small ship in your direction. It keeps its distance and hails you, "We can give you fuel for a price. Just don't even think of doing anything rash. We've got a teleporter at our base and a squad ready to defend us."
A large caravan of merchant ships jumps to a location near your position. Sensing an opportunity, one ship breaks off from the fleet to offer you an exchange.
A modified YT-1300 freighter jumps to an area near your sector. Your gut tells you these people are smugglers, but they seem to be feeling altruistic and present an offer of assistance.

event.name: FUEL_TRADER_DISTRESS
event.title: No fuel: fuel trader (distress on)
event.text: A merchant ship jumps into the sector, obviously responding to your ship's distress beacon. They hail you offering a trade for fuel.
A ship arrives at the beacon. "We noticed your distress signal. I assume you're out of fuel? We're a bit low ourselves but perhaps we can make a trade."
A ship traveling near the beacon approaches your ship and hails you. "Out of fuel? This is a good opportunity for both of us... Care to trade?"
A mercenary ship arrives at the beacon. "We have a bit of extra fuel we can give you... for a price."

event.name: ASTEROID_DERELICT_SHIP
event.title: Dense asteroid field distress
event.text: A ship without life forms within a nearby dense asteroid field is giving off the distress call. Shall we investigate? It could be dangerous.
Hull and engines, random scrap, or the remains.

choice.name: c:dense-asteroid-field-distress:2
choice.text: Make a thorough search for the ship without fear of stray asteroids.

event.text: The remains.

event.name: LANIUS_RESEARCHER_CRAFT
event.title: Lanius craftsmen
event.text: A merchant ship is docked with a Lanius transport. You message them to see if they need any help. It turns out they have been studying the Lanius's ability to reshape metal.
Nothing happens.
Nothing happens.

event.name: SLUG_DISTRESS_QUESTION
event.title: Slug moons question
event.text: You arrive near the distress beacon's signal.
The question follows.
Branched crew and weapon rewards are not granted.

event.name: BOARDERS
event.title: Boarders: Humans (Pirate)
event.text: What appears to be a civilian ship sends a friendly hail. As you approach the vessel, you detect a teleporter signal but it's too late... intruders have beamed aboard!
What appears to be a civilian ship sends a friendly hail. As you approach the vessel, you detect a teleporter signal but it's too late... intruders have beamed aboard!"

A heavily damaged ship is drifting near this beacon. You receive a communication: "Hello! Nice of you to drop by. As you can see, our ship has seen better days. Yours is looking quite nice, I think we might be taking it from you now." Intruders beam aboard.
You detect life-signs actually on the beacon itself! A teleporter signal warns you but it's too late, they've beamed from the beacon onto your ship and seem intent on taking it over.
Your ship detects a faint distress signal on a nearby moon. As you approach the rock, warning lights flash as hostiles beam aboard the ship from some hidden location.
As you arrive, you become aware of a small Rebel outpost near the beacon. You are hardly able to bark an order before a small team is beamed aboard your ship. They must have been expecting you...

choice.name: c:boarders-humans-pirate:0
choice.text: 3-5 human boarders beam aboard your ship.

event.name: ZOLTAN_ODD_MOON
event.title: Zoltan odd moon
event.text: Something strikes you as odd about a moon in the distance.
The moon has more than one result.

event.name: REFUGEE_NO_DISTRESS_ZOLTAN
event.title: Refugee (Zoltan)
event.text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.
A trade, or a Zoltan ship.

event.name: REFUGEE_DISTRESS_ZOLTAN
event.title: Refugee distress (Zoltan)
event.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board.
A trade, or a Zoltan ship.

event.name: ENGI_SURRENDER
event.title: Engi surrender
event.text: An Engi ship in the vicinity, seeing you jump in armed to the teeth, immediately broadcasts its surrender. "Subject goal: wealth. Engi motivation: survival. Transfer of goods acceptable?"
The Engi answer.
The Engi transfer the goods.

event.name: ZOLTAN_CREW_STUDY
event.title: Zoltan research facility
event.text: You arrive at a Zoltan research facility. They say they are researching genetic distortion due to stasis sleep and prolonged FTL travel. They ask if your crew has the time to undergo a few scans.
The Zoltans take their readings.
They pay for the data.

choice.name: c:zoltan-research-facility:3
choice.text: Ask if they can fix this.

event.text:
"Interesting. I've never seen a cryogenic system like this. It appears to still be functioning..." They hook it up to their system and run a number of tests on it.
"Amazing! It has the ability to reconstruct the body if it was damaged during transit. Watch." They reactivate the pod and you watch as the hunks of crystal inside reform to build a humanoid structure. The pod slides open and the re-formed alien steps out.
It speaks slowly, "Greetings. I appear to be in your debt. My people isolated themselves a long time ago, but perhaps it's time to re-establish a connection. There's a hidden wormhole near the Rock home-worlds. Perhaps you can take me there so I can properly repay you?"

event.name: ROCK_QUEST_MARRIAGE_START
event.title: Rock bride
event.text: A rock captain hails you: "It is improper of me to contact off-worlders, but this is an emergency. We were on our way to deliver our passenger to her new husband - the Grand Basilisk of Numa V - when our engines broke down. Will you take possession of her, and make haste to Numa V?"
"You surprise me, off-worlder. Thank you. The passenger will be with you momentarily." She refuses to enter the main hold and prefers to wait in the cargo bay.

event.name: CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON
event.title: Asteroid belt distress
event.text: You follow the distress beacon to a tiny asteroid belt. You find a small ship struggling to maneuver through the field.
They beg for help.

event.name: NEBULA_BATTLEFIELD
event.title: Nebula wreckage
event.text: This nebula looks like it's recently seen two ships exchange fire... with mutually-assured destructive results. Wreckage drifts by your screens and tumbles into the depths of the nebula to be lost to sight. It's hard to determine who the combatants were without closer investigation.

choice.name: c:nebula-wreckage:0
choice.text: Ask your Slug crew to scan for survivors.

event.text: Your Slug finds a survivor.
You search the wreckage.

choice.name: c:nebula-wreckage:2
choice.text: Leave the battlefield before other ships arrive.

event.name: CRYSTAL_CACHE
event.title: Crystalline cache
event.text: Odd radar pings from a huge, orbiting asteroid here reveal a Crystalline cache of some kind. A deep crater has been sealed over with a thick layer of crystal to keep whatever's inside safe — it'd take some serious firepower to break through.

choice.name: c:crystalline-cache:weapons
choice.text: Attempt to break through with the weapons you have.

choice.name: c:crystalline-cache:crystal
choice.text: Have your Crystalline Being recalibrate your weapons.

event.name: DISTRESS_ENGI_REACTOR
event.title: Engi research station
event.text: You arrive at a smoldering Engi research station, its distress call unanswered — attacked by pirates or Mantis most likely. There may be someone left alive, or else something of value left on board.

event.name: ENGI_GIFT
event.title: Free scrap with resources (Engi)
event.text: An Engi vessel hails you. "Identity: Federation? Outlier probability. Implies... revival. Implies... hope. Assistance suggested." They offer some supplies.
You cross paths with an Engi cargo vessel hurrying home before the Mantis fleets attempt to take over this sector. They're happy to offload some of their cargo to get home faster.
You make contact with an isolated Engi science station who are staying put despite the likelihood of Mantis invasion. They suggest you trial some experimental technology.
This was the site of a recent battle. Either a show of Mantis force, or the Engi here weren't disposed to go peacefully. You pick through the pieces.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-engi:take
choice.text: You receive a random amount of scrap with resources.

event.name: ZOLTAN_DISTRESS_SHELL
event.title: Free scrap with resources (Zoltan)
event.text: You arrive to find a lumbering Zoltan freighter with no one at the helm. It's a mystery what happened to the crew, but it'd be a shame to let the opportunity go to waste.

choice.name: c:free-scrap-with-resources-zoltan:take
choice.text: You receive a random amount of scrap with resources.

event.name: ZOLTAN_FREE_MAP
event.title: Zoltan free map
event.text:
The Zoltan stationed near this beacon are happy to receive you. As they give you the formal tour of their ship you spy some local star charts and mentally log the details.
The current sector map is revealed.

event.name: LANIUS_DISTRESS_EMPTY
event.title: Lanius empty distress beacon 1
event.text: You arrive at the location of the distress signal prepared for a fight, but on first glance it's entirely empty. The signal is coming from a small plastic satellite orbiting a moon. A looping message describes how settlers have recently abandoned the area due to the Lanius threat. You fail to find any other signs of a settlement nearby.

event.name: LANIUS_DISTRESS_TOOLATE
event.title: Lanius empty distress beacon 2
event.text: When you get to the beacon you quickly try to locate the source of the distress call. As you are looking, the signal blinks out. It is then that you notice the small fleet of scavenger ships absorbing debris from a large battle nearby. You can't help but wonder where the distress signal came from, but you decide not to risk pressuring the fleet.

event.name: LANIUS_RESEARCHER_CONTACT
event.title: Lanius with Federation science craft
event.text: A Federation science craft is docked with a few Lanius ships. You hail them and ask what is going on. "Greetings! We have been attempting to understand our region's newest visitors, the Lanius, although we have been making little headway in deciphering their language."

choice.name: c:lanius-with-federation-science-craft:ask
choice.text: Ask if they have anything that could help your mission.

choice.name: c:lanius-with-federation-science-craft:lanius
choice.text: Offer to copy your translator's data suite.

event.name: SLUG_DISTRESS_TRICK
event.title: Slug oxygen malfunction
event.text: You find a Slug vessel broadcasting a distress signal and contact them. "Ah, yesss, we are having problems with our oxygen generation unit. Perhaps your crew can assist in repairsss?"

choice.name: c:slug-oxygen-malfunction:mantis
choice.text: Have your Mantis oversee the repairs.

event.name: NEBULA_SLUG_HULLFIX
event.title: Slug repair station
event.text: You arrive to find a small Slug repair station. "Greetingsss traveller! Care for a fix up? We could eassily patch up ssome of that damage."

choice.name: c:slug-repair-station:pay
choice.text: Ask if they would like payment.

event.name: NEBULA_SLUG_FAKE_STORE
event.title: Slug store ship
event.text: A Slug transport ship is stationed near the beacon with a military escort ship. They message you, "We have been waiting for a customer for agesss. Care to see our waresss?"

event.name: ROCK_SLUG_ARGUMENT_NEBULA
event.title: Slug and Rock standoff in nebula
event.alias: Slug and Rock standoff in nebula
event.text: You detect multiple ships running at maximum power nearby, but you can't see anything through this thick nebula.

event.name: arrive-mantis-chase
event.title: Mantis trail
event.text:
You catch up with the Mantis ship that escaped before, only to see them transferring their crew into an even bigger ship!
"Not YOU again! Do you know how much these repairs are going to cost me? Time to take out the big guns."

event.name: arrive-slug-pirate-trap
event.title: Slug raid
event.text:
You catch up with the two Slug ships and they're already carrying out their raid! One is in close combat with the pirate, the other seems to be heading for a small space cache the pirate was protecting.
Suddenly the first ship bursts into flames, and an urgent call arrives from the remaining Slugs. "We sssugest you distract the pirate vesssel while we retrieve the valuables. Fifty fifty sssplit."

event.name: arrive-engi-real
event.title: Rebel base
event.text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one scout ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.

event.name: arrive-engi-fake
event.title: Rebel base
event.text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one scout ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.

event.name: arrive-engi-final
event.title: Mantis convoy
event.text: You have finally caught up with the ships you've been hunting. A hangar-sized cargo ship is being escorted by a number of Mantis ships. As you reconsider the assault, a squadron of Engi ships with pirate emblems jump in and assist you. You prepare to fight the Mantis but scans indicate they are manned by Rebels!

event.name: arrive-slug-platform
event.title: Construction platform
event.text: You arrive to discover an impressive cruiser being worked on by a few smaller ships and guarded by an assault ship. The mobile construction platform is slowly slipping into the clouds. You have not yet been noticed.

choice.name: q:slug-platform:tail
choice.text: Try to tail them without being noticed.

event.name: arrive-store-rescue
event.title: Space dock
event.text: Once you arrive at the beacon you detect a Rebel scout assaulting a compound on a nearby desolate moon.

choice.name: q:store-rescue:engage
choice.text: Engage the Rebel and rescue the space dock.

event.name: arrive-rock-sun
event.title: Red giant
event.text: You arrive at the coordinates given and find yourself dangerously close to an M-class star! The other ship messages you, "Let's see how long your puny ship can handle this heat! Prepare for a challenge!"

event.name: arrive-zoltan-peace
event.title: Zoltan brethren
event.text: You arrive at the location specified by the peace-loving Zoltan, but the only thing nearby is a Rebel ship, closing in fast! "We've found you! You're not getting away this time!"

event.name: arrive-rock-bride
event.title: Numa V
event.text:
A vast tunnel network near the surface of Numa V indicates an advanced Rock civilization. This must be where you were asked to deliver the passenger.
Realizing arrival is imminent, your passenger - silent so far - pleads with you not to hand her over. She's interrupted by the Grand Basilisk's Chief Aide: "To the alien vessel holding the Basilisk's wife. Deliver her to us. You will be rewarded... well."

event.name: arrive-zoltan-primitives
event.title: Primitive planet
event.text:
You arrive at the primitive planet that you heard about at the cantina and are surprised to see a Zoltan ship facing off against a Rebel assault craft.
You tap into their frequency and hear the Rebel captain yelling, "We are liberating this planet in the name of the new Galactic government! These aliens will not be left in ignorance where they cannot be of use!"

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:0
choice.text: Interfere - make first contact with the primitive aliens

choice.name: c:zoltan-quest-primitives:1
choice.text: Protect the aliens' way of life - Attack the Rebel ship

event.name: arrive-capture-ship
event.title: Bandit ship
event.text: You find the ship that you were asked to capture intact. You're not sure why, but they stressed that it's of great importance that you kill the crew WITHOUT destroying the ship.

choice.name: s:slug-home-nebula-surrender:info
choice.text: Let them live. We don't want the weapon, we want information.

event.text: You ask where they were delivering the weapon. "By telling you we will probably die jussst as like as not... Oh well." They give you the coordinates of the a prototype cruiser's mobile construction platform.
"Great, we'll relay their coordinates. Remember, do NOT destroy that ship! Remember, we'll be right behind you."
"At least you're confident, for what little that's worth. Here is their last known location."

choice.name: q:nebula:comfort
choice.text: Make them comfortable for their final moments.

event.text: On their death bed, they croak out a series of coordinates and beg you to go there - when you attempt to ask them why, the survivor simply says, "ABADOTH" and perishes.
You input their coordinates into your map and prepare to follow.

surrender.text: When the pirate ship looks ready to break apart you notice the Slug ship has secured the loot and is preparing to jump away!
surrender.result: The pirate's too badly damaged to pursue you, and you catch up to the Slugs before they jump. "Ah, of courssse, we would never leave without providing the agreed upon ssspoils." They transfer over a decent chunk of the profits and set off.

choice.name: surrender-accept
choice.text: Let the pirate escape and go after the Slugman ship.

surrender.result: "Of course, that's why you're here. Yes, they passed by here but I had nothing to do with it, I don't know what they were carrying. I'll transmit coordinates. Now just let us go..." You prepare an FTL message containing the coordinates to send to the Engies and get ready to jump.

choice.name: surrender-accept
choice.text: Demand information on the stolen technology.

surrender.text: "Stop! I don't want to die here."

choice.name: surrender-accept
choice.text: Demand information on the stolen technology.

card.text: "Ah, so that's what you're after. Too bad, you followed the wrong ship. The envoy that passed through here was a fake, to trick fools like you. Now let us go!"

surrender.text: "Look, you proved your point. We don't want to die... Take this and let us go. Please?"
surrender.result: "Thank you. But do you have any idea how much repairing TWO ships will set us back?..." What an odd Mantis. You prepare to leave.

event.name: DONOR_PLAGUE
event.title: Plagued station
event.text: You arrive near a damaged and dilapidated space station. It appears to be abandoned but you detect faint life signatures on board.

choice.name: c:plagued-station:0
choice.text: Board the station and look for survivors.

event.text: A random amount of scrap.

event.name: DONOR_PONY
event.title: Intelligent ponies
event.text: Scanners are showing intelligent life forms on a nearby planet. No match for them can be found in the database.
Three follow-up choices.

event.name: TERRAFORMING_SCAN
event.title: Terraforming scan
event.text: You receive a hail from a station orbiting a nearby planet. "Captain, we are Federation Terraforming Team C12 and are in need of assistance. Do you have some time?"
They ask for a scan.

event.name: NEBULA_EMPTY
event.title: Empty nebula beacon
event.text: There's nothing here, save for vast swirls of gas reflecting rays from a distant sun.

event.name: STORM_ITEMS
event.title: Plasma storm incapacitated ships
event.text: You jump into the middle of a plasma storm. Multiple recently incapacitated ships loom in the shadows, briefly illuminated by the lightning.

choice.name: c:plasma-storm-incapacitated-ships:0
choice.text: Manually search the wreckage for survivors and equipment.

choice.name: c:plasma-storm-incapacitated-ships:1
choice.text: Avoid the risk and wait to jump away unscathed.

choice.name: c:plasma-storm-incapacitated-ships:2
choice.text: Have your pilot carefully explore the debris.

event.name: FRIENDLY_BEACON
event.title: Friendly ship out of fuel
event.text: "Greetings! It is so good to see you! We've been out of fuel and floating out here for weeks. We were terrified a pirate or those damn Rebels would find us first. Could you spare some fuel?"

choice.name: c:friendly-ship-out-of-fuel:1
choice.text: Apologize, wish them luck, and continue on.

event.name: REFUGEE_GHOST
event.title: Refugee comms down
event.text: You have encountered a refugee ship drifting in space. It looks as if it was fleeing the Rebel advance and ran out of fuel. Its distress beacon is active, but you're not sure anyone is on board, and its communications seem to be down.

event.name: TRADER_UPGRADES
event.title: Trade scrap for upgrades
event.text: You pick up an automated message from a nearby space station. There appears to be a local shipwright that can perform emergency work on military ships.
There are a number of privately owned ship construction platforms in the area. You find one that has a slot open for some immediate work.
You receive a message from a small refugee convoy, "Hail. We'd like to help you on your mission but don't have much to offer. If you have extra metal perhaps we could work on your ship?"
You are immediately hailed by a mobile docking platform upon arrival, "Welcome to Uncle Joe's Fix-it Shop! Need a tune-up? We got you covered!"
One printed upgrade offer.

event.name: HELP_MINERS
event.title: Asteroid mining colony
event.text: You come across an asteroid mining colony. They message you immediately, saying, "Greetings. Our supplies of mining explosives have run out ever since the Rebels blockaded this system. Do you have any extra explosives?"

choice.name: c:asteroid-mining-colony:0
choice.text: Offer to solve their problem by launching a missile.

event.name: TRADER_UPGRADES_EXCHANGE
event.title: Improve reactor for supplies
event.text: You receive a message from a small convoy. They're looking for some military supplies and are offering to try to improve your reactor in exchange.
"You look like a military vessel. We're trying to get back to our homes alive. I'm an engineer by trade and could try to improve your reactor if you have any extra supplies."
You receive a message from a small convoy. They're looking for some military supplies and are offering to try to improve your reactor in exchange.
One printed supply bundle.

event.name: DISTRESS_INFESTATION
event.title: Giant alien spiders
event.text: You find a number of ships fleeing from a small space station. You hail them, asking what's wrong: "Help! We're being overrun by some sort of giant alien spiders!"

choice.name: c:giant-alien-spiders:0
choice.text: Send the crew to help! Giant alien spiders are no joke.

event.text: A crewmember, or high resources with some scrap.

choice.name: c:giant-alien-spiders:2
choice.text: Send your battle drone in to help.

event.text: Medium resources with some scrap.

choice.name: c:giant-alien-spiders:3
choice.text: Launch a Boarding drone into the station.

event.text: Low scrap with resources.

choice.name: c:giant-alien-spiders:4
choice.text: Use the beam to pick off the spiders.

event.text: High resources with some scrap.

event.name: DISTRESS_STATION_DISEASE
event.title: Unknown disease on mining colony
event.text: You locate a nearby human mining colony where an unknown disease has spread virulently. They are setting up a quarantine to contain it but a riot has broken out.

choice.name: c:unknown-disease-on-mining-colony:0
choice.text: Send in your crew to help control the crowds.

event.text: A crewmember and medium resources, or nothing.

choice.name: c:unknown-disease-on-mining-colony:1
choice.text: Ignore their request and move on.

choice.name: c:unknown-disease-on-mining-colony:2
choice.text: Send your Rock crew-member to prevent a riot.

event.text: Medium resources with some scrap.

choice.name: c:unknown-disease-on-mining-colony:3
choice.text: Send your Engi to calm down the infected.

event.text: Medium resources with some scrap.

choice.name: c:unknown-disease-on-mining-colony:4
choice.text: Use your medbay to help synthesize a cure.

event.text: Medium resources, or high scrap.

event.name: DISTRESS_STATION_FIRE
event.title: Fire on research station
event.text: You find the source of the distress call, a small research station. It appears a small laboratory fire got out of control and is threatening to destroy the station. Their fire suppression system is not responding.

choice.name: c:fire-on-research-station:0
choice.text: Send your crew in a shuttle to help put out the fire.

event.text: A crewmember and low scrap, or high scrap.

choice.name: c:fire-on-research-station:1
choice.text: Dock and try to rescue the survivors.

event.text: 4 hull, 1 system damage, and low scrap, or Dr. Jones and low scrap.
High scrap and a random augmentation.

choice.name: c:fire-on-research-station:4
choice.text: Send your repair drone into the fire.

event.text: High scrap and a random drone schematic.

event.name: STRANDED_BEACON
event.title: Single life form on moon
event.text: It appears the distress beacon is coming from the surface of a nearby moon. Your sensors are picking up a single life form.

choice.name: c:single-life-form-on-moon:0
choice.text: Go down to the surface to investigate.

event.text: Charlie, a crewmember, 5 hull, or scrap and repairs.

event.name: DISTRESS_SATELLITE_DEFENSE
event.title: Malfunctioning defense system
event.text: The distress signal is coming from a small space station orbiting an uninhabited planet. Their satellite defense system has gone haywire and their repair crew can't approach without being fired on. They're looking for help to fix or disable it.
Ion, cloaking, an Engi, or low scrap. The 5 hull result stays unwired.

event.name: TAVERN_HIRE
event.title: Crew hiring station
event.text: This Beacon seems to serve as meeting place for local traffic. It seems you can find crew willing to fight on your ship here... for a price.
You find a space station set up for travelers. Browsing through its listings, you find a tavern full of mercenaries for hire. You look for potential crewmembers.
There are a number of ships stationed around a rest stop. You immediately receive a message saying, "If you're looking for some bodies to fill your ship, you've come to the right place!"

event.name: filler-refueling-station
event.title: Refueling station
event.text: A ship re-fueling station is stationed at this beacon. We can purchase fuel here.

event.name: STORE
event.title: Store
event.text: A trading post hangs at this beacon, open for business.

event.name: STORE_REBELSIDE
event.title: Large trade station
event.text: You come across a large trade station. However, as soon as you approach a warning goes out to all ships in the region: "Do not associate with the Federation sympathizer. All who oppose the Rebels will be punished."
You decide it's better not to push your luck and move on.

event.name: STANDIN_GATES
event.title: STANDIN_GATES
event.text: Gates.
